location_text: Outdoor table at a San Pedro Square restaurant
summary: A diner's phone was grabbed from an outdoor table. The suspect fled on foot toward St. John Street.

location_text: From a bar in San Pedro Square, several blocks toward a hotel lobby on Santa Clara Street
summary: A woman said a man who had watched her inside a bar followed her for several blocks. She took refuge in a hotel lobby; no arrest was made.

location_text: Near San Pedro Square Market entrance
summary: A fight spilled from a nearby bar onto the sidewalk, leaving two men with minor injuries. One man was cited for battery.

location_text: St. James Park, walking toward 1st Street
summary: A student was verbally harassed and blocked from leaving by a group of three people while cutting through the park. The student walked away toward 1st Street.

location_text: St. James and 3rd streets, northeast corner of St. James Park
summary: A cyclist was pushed off his bike and the bike was stolen. The rider suffered scrapes and the suspect rode toward Julian Street.

location_text: VTA light rail southbound on 2nd Street, exited near Paseo de San Antonio (date vague: 'last week')
summary: A woman reported a man repeatedly touched her and made sexual comments on light rail. VTA is reviewing camera footage.

location_text: Parking lot next to Diridon Station
summary: A laptop and backpack were stolen from a parked car after its rear window was smashed. Police said there have been several vehicle break-ins near the station this month.
Several people reported online a man approaching pedestrians and demanding money over several weeks, mostly at night. Police have received a few calls but no confirmed location.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: A woman's purse was grabbed from her shoulder. The suspect ran north on 3rd Street and she was not hurt.

location_text: North 3rd Street edge of St. James Park
summary: A pedestrian was punched by a stranger and treated for a bloody nose. The attacker fled on foot.

location_text: From light rail toward St. James Park along North 3rd Street, ending at 3rd and St. James streets
summary: A woman reported a man followed her and kept pace with her along North 3rd Street. The man walked away before officers arrived.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: A group of men shouted at two students, made crude comments and tried to block their path. The students crossed the street and reported it to campus police.

location_text: Santa Clara Street light rail stop on 2nd Street
summary: A rider's phone was snatched from his hand while waiting at the stop. The suspect ran east on Santa Clara Street.

location_text: Light rail platform on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A man stood close to a woman, made sexual comments and wouldn't leave her alone. VTA security escorted her onto the next train.

location_text: Light rail stop on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: An argument turned into a fight, leaving one person with minor injuries. Police detained one man.

location_text: Light rail stop on 1st Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A backpack containing a laptop was taken from a bench while its owner looked at the train schedule. Police are reviewing camera footage.
